name: Shashinkan
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood photo studio: a regular-closing-day notice, a first day helping at reception, a shichigosan/seijin-shiki photography price guide, a same-day ID-photo finishing notice, a new camera-assistant training comparison, a story about noticing a regular customer's change in expression through good service, a trainee lesson on camera and lighting basics, an explainer on why an old darkroom is still kept, an on-location photography set application guide, a column on how more phone photographers changed the studio's work, a shichigosan-season reservation rule, a column on the meaning of a studio's light-adjustment craft, and a one-year photo-studio-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
